governance: Master Admin controlled; common FAQ and public Help are available before and after login; anonymous login/registration/OTP/access support tickets use a claimed mobile/email and require ticket number plus the same contact identifier for tracking/comments; authenticated users use verified session contact for full support.

items.question: How do I log in?
items.answer: Use your username, email, or mobile number with your password. If you cannot sign in, use Forgot Password or the public Help AI.

items.question: I did not receive my OTP. What should I do?
items.answer: Check the registered email or mobile number, wait for delivery, and use Resend Code. Never share an OTP with another person.

items.question: How do I reset my password?
items.answer: Choose Forgot Password on the login screen, verify the OTP sent to a registered contact, and create a new password.

items.question: How do I create a help ticket?
items.answer: Without login, use public Help AI to get guidance and create a support ticket for login, registration, OTP or access problems by providing a mobile number or email address. The ticket number plus the same contact identifier can be used to track the ticket and add comments. After login, you can create full AI-assisted support tickets using the verified contact associated with your session.

items.question: Where can I find my saved works?
items.answer: After login, open Library to view saved works and reading history. Account-specific library data is available only to the authenticated user.

items.question: What happens if my selected language is unavailable?
items.answer: When the selected language is unavailable or unsupported, the governed UI falls back to English. For an enabled language with a missing reviewed translation, the governed localization policy applies its explicit missing-key behavior.
